items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Albert Clemler was playing drums and I was playing piano.

ctx.x: And then you left that job and what happened then?

What did you do then? Yeah. Adams Brothers, I think one of them was playing up on St. Charlesbury. I don't know what they called it. Albert Clemler was playing drums and I was playing piano. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
